name: CubingUSA New England Quiet Championship 2026

venue.name: Wells Ogunquit Senior Center
venue.details: The room is to the left of the main entrance

information:
This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion. 

The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 Blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition, such as the main championship two weeks later.
